title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Adam corrupted when he first sinned; we when born
pass_a_gloss: Ask the times apart. When was Adam corrupted? When he first sinned. When were we corrupted by the communion we have with him? When we were begotten. What difficulty remains in that split?
pass_b_english: If therefore I ask, When was Adam corrupted? I will answer, when he first sinned. When were we corrupted by force of the communion which we have with Adam? Answer, when we were begotten. What difficulty is there in that matter?
source_text: Si ergo quaero, Quando Adamus corruptus fuit? respondebo, cum primum peccavit. Quando corrupti fuimus vi communionis quam cum Adamo habemus? Resp. quando geniti sumus. Quid est in ea re difficultatis?

choices.choice: Adam at first sin; we at birth by communion
